output.question: What is Sysco's annual revenue?
output.answer: Sysco's (NYSE: SYY) latest full-year revenue is $84.6 billion for fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026. That is 3.9% more than fiscal 2025, when sales were about $81.37 billion. Sysco reported the results on August 4, 2026. Fourth-quarter sales rose 4.7% to $22.1 billion. For fiscal 2027, which runs 53 weeks, Sysco guided to roughly 6%–7% sales growth.

key_facts.fact: Sysco's fiscal 2026 sales (fiscal year ended June 27, 2026) rose 3.9% to $84.6 billion.
Fiscal 2025 full-year sales were $81,370 million, according to the consolidated results table.
Q4 fiscal 2026 sales rose 4.7% to $22.1 billion.

passages.quote: Sales for fiscal year 2026 increased 3.9% to $84.6 billion.
announced financial results for its 13-week fourth fiscal quarter and its fiscal year ended June 27, 2026
Sales for the fourth quarter increased 4.7% to $22.1 billion.

caveats: Sysco's fiscal year ends in late June or early July, so 'annual revenue' here means fiscal 2026 (July 2025 to June 27, 2026), not the calendar year.
$84.6 billion is the rounded headline figure. The exact number in millions comes from the release's financial tables and the FY2026 10-K, and I didn't pull it from either.
Trailing-twelve-month revenue that includes Q1 fiscal 2027 (reported around late October 2026) may differ slightly. I didn't verify Q1 FY27 results.
The $58.8 billion figure that some coverage cites is U.S. Foodservice segment sales only, not Sysco's total.
